title: Detecting Inappropriate Messages on Sensitive Topics that Could Harm a Company’s Reputation
benchmark_measurement: Detection of inappropriate statements about religion, defined as messages on a sensitive topic that could harm a speaker's reputation, such as by insulting the feelings of religious people.
findings: The developed BERT-based topic classifier was most successful at identifying texts related to the 'religion' category, achieving the highest F1-score (approximately 0.95) among all 18 sensitive topics evaluated.
